subject: Draft AWS listing copy & co-sell plan — quick review
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightscale.dev>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft AWS listing copy & co-sell plan — quick review

Emma —

Thanks again for the time on the call this morning. I promised to send a tight draft of the AWS Marketplace product page copy plus a short co-sell action plan so your GTM team can review. See the two attachments: aws_listing_draft.md (copy + hero/benefit bullets) and co-sell_action_plan.xlsx (roles, milestones, handoffs).

High-level asks:
- Can BrightScale confirm the product description tone is accurate and that the example usage scenarios map to your customer stories?
- Any compliance/branding constraints on the logo asset (attached as brightscale_logo.svg)?
- Can you share any preferred SKUs or trial/entitlement language we should mirror?

Proposed next steps:
1) BrightScale to comment inline on the doc by EOD Thu (11/5)
2) Redwood to incorporate final copy and send for legal/marketplace checks by Mon (11/9)
3) Agree on co-sell kickoff and initial pilot customer list (slot in a 30-min alignment next week)

If it helps I pulled the primary landing blurb into the email below so you can skim the headline quickly.

Draft headline + lead (from aws_listing_draft.md):
"Redwood Inference for BrightScale — enterprise LLM inference that scales with predictable latency and lower per-token costs."

Lead bullets (short):
• Production-grade inference runtime tuned for high throughput and bursty workloads
• Transparent cost controls: batching, KV cache, and quantization profiles
• Deployment flexibility: hosted API, dedicated pools, and private VPC installs

Thanks — happy to hop on another quick call if you want to walk through edits.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: aws_listing_draft.md (text/md), co-sell_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), brightscale_logo.svg (image)

From: Emma Li <emma@brightscale.dev>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@brightscale.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing copy & co-sell plan — quick review

Karthik —

Thanks for sending. Overall this reads well and the value bullets align with what we want to emphasize for customers. Quick notes inline (I attached a copy with comments):
- Headline: prefer we emphasize "predictable inference economics" over "lower per-token costs" — our finance team is sensitive about hard cost claims in marketplace collateral.
- Usage scenarios: please add an example for "real-time agent orchestration" (we have two pilot customers here).
- Logo: the attached SVG is fine but we need a version with white background for dark hero (I'll attach it separately if useful).

Co-sell plan comments:
- On milestones sheet: move the pilot customer introductions to Week 1 rather than Week 2.
- We'd like a single point of contact for field enablement — assign someone from Redwood by next Tuesday.

I've attached: brightscale_comments.pdf (annotated copy), brightscale_logo_light.svg (image).

I'll have our legal review the proposed entitlement language and get back by Monday.

–Emma
Emma Li
Head of GTM Partnerships
BrightScale

Attachments: brightscale_comments.pdf (pdf), brightscale_logo_light.svg (image)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightscale.dev>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft AWS listing copy & co-sell plan — quick review

Emma — thanks for the quick turn. I pulled your pdf into the doc and made a few edits; main updates below and I also pushed them into aws_listing_draft.md: 

Edits we made
- Headline change: swapped language to "Predictable inference economics for production LLMs" to avoid an explicit cost claim.
- Added a usage scenario paragraph for Real-time agent orchestration with a short customer example (pilot A/B).
- Adjusted hero layout so the logo has a white background fallback and added alt-text guidance for accessibility.

Open items we still need from BrightScale:
1) Legal's final wording for entitlement/trial limits (you mentioned Monday)
2) Confirm the primary pilot customer name for Week 1 intro (or let us list a placeholder if you'd rather us reach out to them first)
3) Field enablement POC — we can assign Marissa as the Redwood POC for the first 60 days unless you prefer a product engineer.

Operational ask: once legal signs off on entitlement language we need to route the final copy through Marketplace Ops (they usually need 72 hours). Can you confirm if your legal team has a procurement contact we should loop in?

If everything looks good I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Thu with Marissa + your enablement lead.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Programs Lead
Redwood Inference

Emma —

Appreciate the detailed pass. Per Kimberly's edits and your notes, we're aligned on the headline and the added usage scenario. Marissa will be the Redwood POC for enablement (cc'ed) — Marissa, can you confirm availability for a 30-min kickoff on Thu 11/12 or Fri 11/13?

Procurement/legal: Emma, if you can share the procurement contact or the legal redline thread, we'll add them to the HubSpot deal and queue the marketplace ops checklist. Once legal signs off we'll push to Marketplace Ops and plan the co-sell kickoff.

Next steps I'm executing now:
- Upload final copy and assets to the shared Drive (link below)
- Create HubSpot task for Marketplace Ops with a 72-hour SLA after legal OK
- Prepare a short seller enablement slide deck for the kickoff

DocuSign step: I'm attaching the external offer paperwork and will route a DocuSign link after legal confirms the entitlement language — quick note: we usually keep trial SKUs open for 90 days for pilots. If that needs to be shorter let us know.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-aws-listing-assets
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/6123456/BR-8423
DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/BR-8423/offer-agreement

Thanks all — looking forward to getting this live next week.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships (marketplace)
Redwood Inference
